notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
description:
Activate Tetzimoc by paying 2 life and revealing it from your hand, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
The Tetzimoc ability fails to resolve  due to no longer having a legal target.
The creature dies, triggering Dross Harvester, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
